name: Meteobar
author: mryll
description: Open-Meteo weather (meteobar) in the Omarchy bar: condition glyph + temperature, with an hourly and daily forecast panel.

barWidget.description: Click: forecast panel. Middle click: refresh.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to fetch the forecast. Open-Meteo publishes hourly, so anything under 10 minutes fetches the same numbers again.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Metric is °C, km/h and mm; imperial is °F, mph and inches. Applies to the bar, the tooltip and the panel at once.

schema.label: Temperature unit
schema.description: follow: whatever Units gives (°C metric, °F imperial). Set it on its own to mix, e.g. celsius alongside mph wind.

schema.label: Wind speed unit
schema.description: follow: whatever Units gives (km/h metric, mph imperial). Set mph alongside metric units for the UK convention of °C temperatures and mph wind.

schema.label: Location
schema.description: City name, 'City, Province' or 'City, CC' (meteobar's geocoding disambiguation). Empty auto-detects by IP.

schema.label: Icon set
schema.description: Glyph family for condition icons. 'fontawesome' requires otf-font-awesome >= 7.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Monochrome rendering uses foreground tones only — severity stays readable through the numbers and glyphs. none: no color anywhere. bar-only: colored bar face, plain panel. panel-only: the reverse.
